claim_text: Decathlon confirms malicious access to customer data at an outside provider on Nov 22
summary: Decathlon told France 3 and Ouest-France that there was malicious access to personal data in France on Nov 22, 2026, at one of its outside providers, and not in its main customer account database.
detail: Decathlon has not named the provider and has published no notice of its own.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: France 3: Decathlon confirms an "accès malveillant à des données personnelles ... s'est produit en France le 22 novembre 2026", "chez l'un de ses prestataires externes". Clubic: confirmed to Ouest-France.
notes: Ouest-France could not be read (blocked); Clubic carries its account.

claim_text: Names, phone numbers and addresses of some decathlon.fr customers were reached
summary: Decathlon says the data concerned includes identities, phone numbers and addresses, of some customers who placed an order on decathlon.fr, and that they will be told by email.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: France 3: "notamment l'identité, numéros de téléphone et adresses"; "certains clients ayant effectué une commande sur le site decathlon.fr". Clubic gives the same from Ouest-France.

claim_text: Decathlon says no bank details or passwords were affected
summary: Decathlon says no bank data or passwords were affected. Cyberattaque.org, which examined the posted files, found no account passwords, full card numbers or bank account numbers in them.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: France 3 quotes Decathlon: "aucune donnée bancaire ni mots de passe n'ont été impactés". Cyberattaque.org: no password, full card number or IBAN identified in the files.

claim_text: A hacker posted four files of Decathlon customer records on a criminal forum
summary: Four files said to come from Decathlon were posted on a hacking forum on Nov 22-23. Cyberattaque.org counted 163,646 records in the main file, with 137,549 distinct email addresses and 135,586 phone numbers.
detail: A person can appear more than once, so the number of people is lower than the number of records. The forum was not visited.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Cyberattaque.org: "163 646 fiches avec 137 549 adresses email distinctes". France 3 and Clubic cite the same count from Cyberattaque.org.

claim_text: The files include order history and some deliveries due this week
summary: Cyberattaque.org found more than 250,000 order lines from July 2021 to Nov 21, 2026, about 600 deliveries scheduled for Nov 23 to 28, and over 4,100 records with delivery notes such as building access instructions.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Cyberattaque.org: "255 011 lignes de commandes" from July 2021 to Nov 21, 2026, and deliveries "programmées jusqu'au 28 novembre". France 3: "plus de 4 100 fiches contiennent un commentaire de livraison".

claim_text: Decathlon says it blocked the access and will email affected customers
summary: Decathlon says its teams stepped in at once to block the compromised access, and that the customers concerned will be contacted by email.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: France 3 quotes Decathlon: "Nos équipes sont immédiatement intervenues pour bloquer l'accès compromis"; customers "vont être contactés par email". Clubic gives the same from Ouest-France.

claim_text: Decathlon will report the leak to the CNIL
summary: Clubic reports that Decathlon will notify the CNIL, France's data protection authority, of the incident.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Clubic: "L'enseigne va aussi signaler l'incident à la CNIL".

claim_text: The outside provider has not been named
summary: Decathlon says the access happened at one of its outside providers. It has not said which. Cyberattaque.org says the files look like they come from a logistics or delivery tool, but cannot identify the provider.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: France 3: "chez l'un de ses prestataires externes". Cyberattaque.org: "Aucun élément ne permet pour l'instant d'identifier un prestataire précis."

claim_text: Decathlon warns that fraudsters copy its look in fake emails to get personal and bank details
summary: Decathlon's page on phishing warns that people regularly pose as Decathlon in fake emails, sites and social media accounts, copying its logo and colours, to get personal data and bank details.
detail: Outlets advise decathlon.fr customers to distrust unexpected messages about a parcel or delivery fees.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Decathlon: people "tentent d'usurper l'identité de Decathlon via de faux mails" to reach "vos données personnelles et surtout, à vos informations bancaires".

claim_text: France 3 reports no link, so far, with the TrainMe leak in October
summary: In October a data leak at a provider of TrainMe, Decathlon's sports coaching subsidiary, was confirmed. France 3 says the two events have no link at this stage.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: France 3: "Ces deux événements n'ont à ce stade aucun lien."

claim_text: Decathlon is a sports retailer founded in 1976 with about 1,800 stores
summary: Decathlon designs and sells sporting goods. It was founded in 1976 in Englos, in northern France, and has 101,100 staff and 1,817 stores worldwide, 325 of them in France.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Decathlon: "Avec 101 100 coéquipiers et 1 817 magasins dans le monde entier"; "1976 Création de Decathlon"; "325 magasins" in France.

claim_text: Decathlon has not said how many customers are affected
summary: Decathlon has not given the number of customers concerned. The record counts come from Cyberattaque.org's analysis of the posted files.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Clubic: "on ne sait pas encore combien de clients recevront ce message". France 3 gives the counts from Cyberattaque.org.
